sources.entry: Torrent Preview - Quick Look extension for previewing .torrent files, trackers, and metadata. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/sveinbjornpalsson/torrentpreview/) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A macOS QuickLook extension that previews .torrent files directly in Finder so you can inspect their contents without opening a torrent client.
summary.what_it_does: Adds a Quick Look preview for .torrent files: select one in Finder and press Space. The preview shows the file list with sizes and type-specific icons, total size, file count, and piece info. It also lists trackers and metadata such as creation date, creator, comments, and info hash. A private-torrent indicator is shown, and both single-file and multi-file torrents are handled.
use_cases: Inspect a .torrent file's contents before downloading
Check which trackers a torrent uses
Find a torrent's info hash or creation date
Confirm whether a torrent is marked private
Preview torrent file sizes in Finder
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the Releases page
Move Torrent Preview.app to your Applications folder
Launch the app once to register the extension
Select any .torrent file in Finder and press Space
Build from source: clone the repo and open TorrentPreview.xcodeproj in Xcode
If previews don't appear, run: qlmanage -r
notable: Native macOS Quick Look integration, so previews work from Finder's Space bar
Shows tracker list and metadata (creation date, creator, comments, info hash)
caveats: If previews don't appear after install, the QuickLook cache may need resetting with qlmanage -r
